question: outcome_summary
answer: The study will evaluate the feasibility and acceptability of the Autism Adapted Safety Plans (AASPs) for autistic adults, focusing on completion rates of assessments at the 6-month follow-up. Key metrics include usability ratings on the System Usability Scale and satisfaction scores on the Client Satisfaction Questionnaire-8. The study will also compare the AASP with traditional suicide screening tools and assess cultural sensitivity. Feedback from participants will be integrated to refine the AASP and enhance its effectiveness.

question: demographics_summary
answer: Participants are autistic adults aged 18 years or older with a clinical diagnosis of autism and a self-reported history of self-harm or suicidal thoughts within the last six months. Sufficient spoken English is required to complete the assessments, and individuals currently experiencing psychotic symptoms are excluded. The study aims to address the unique needs of this demographic group, considering factors like age, gender, and socioeconomic status.
